faq.a: Shahan Ali — known online as PROBOY, ProBoy, itx_proboy, shahan315, and proboy315 — is a Full-Stack Developer, AI & WhatsApp Bot Architect, and Shopify Expert based in Burewala, Punjab, Pakistan. He is currently an ICS student at Govt Graduate College Burewala and builds web applications, the ProBoy-MD WhatsApp bot, custom Shopify stores, and Gemini AI tools.

faq.q: Is this Shahan Ali the same person as Shahan Ali Mohsin or Shahan Ali Jamil?
faq.a: No. This website belongs to Shahan Ali (PROBOY / proboy315 / shahan315), a software developer and ICS student in Burewala, Punjab, Pakistan. He is not affiliated with Shahan Ali Mohsin (the Indian motorsport racing driver) or Shahan Ali Jamil (the corporate executive associated with EcoPack).

faq.q: What services does Shahan Ali offer?
faq.a: Shahan Ali provides four core development services: Full-Stack Web Development (React, TypeScript, Node.js), WhatsApp Bot Development & Automation (Node.js, Baileys multi-device architecture), Shopify Development (Online Store 2.0 and Liquid), and AI Integrations & Automation (Google Gemini APIs and workflow tools).

ProBoy-MD is an open-source Node.js WhatsApp Multi-Device bot created by Shahan Ali (proboy315) using the Baileys library. The repository contains 224 verified command files across 9 categories (general, ai, group, dev, media, fun, utility, textmaker, and admin) using a '.' prefix.

faq.q: What credential did Shahan Ali earn in 2026?
faq.a: Shahan Ali earned a Certificate of Recognition for Google Gemini QuizOff 2026 (dated 19 July 2026), organised by CampusCrew and hosted on Unstop.
